title: Peterborough author launches new book 'Grace Kimball' - Monadnock Ledger-Transcript
text:
Peterborough author Betsy Gilcreast has released a new novel, “GRACE KIMBALL ~ Flawed but Fabulous.”
Known for her short stories and first novel, Gilcreast said the book “took a while to write,” noting that “the main character was not always cooperative.”
The novel follows Grace Kimball as she navigates life’s challenges while trying to outrun her mother’s often prejudicial advice. Grace confronts the consequences of her poor choices and unwise decisions but continues to believe in love and the wonder of shooting stars.
Gilcreast’s previous works include “The Maude Spacely” mysteries and “And Buried Softly.” Her earlier short stories appeared in “Writer’s Block.” Her books are available through Amazon.
